raw:
I felt proud when a kite I’d made finally stayed up in the air. I was out by the dunes, and I’d put a longer tail on it, cut from an old sheet. It was homemade, nothing fancy, but I wanted to get it to fly.

What I remember most is watching it stay up above the dunes instead of coming down again. I kept thinking, “It’s actually working.” It stayed in the air for ten minutes. That might not sound like much, but when you’ve made something yourself, seeing it do what you hoped it would feels wonderful. I was proud that I’d kept at it and got it flying.
